title: Self Service Notifications in Zscaler Client Connector in the Classic UI

blocks.text: This article provides information about the Classic UI version of the app available with Zscaler Client Connector versions earlier than 5.0. To learn more about the Modern UI version of the app available with Zscaler Client Connector version 5.0, see Using Zscaler Client Connector in the Modern UI.

After the admins have configured the Self Service settings, users receive notifications when issues are detected and need attention. Each notification contains a brief diagnosis and recommendation that might resolve the CPU or Wi-Fi issue.
For the minimum required version compatibility for Self Service, see Supported Versions & Feature Compatibility.

blocks.heading: Enabling and Disabling Notifications in Zscaler Client Connector

blocks.text: In Zscaler Client Connector, you can enable or disable the Self Service notifications:

blocks.item: From the left-side navigation, click More.
Under Settings, enable the toggle for Show Self Service notification popups.
